item.title: Arizona appeals court upholds divorce asset division
item.description: An Arizona couple, married in 2016, built three businesses before filing for divorce in 2023. During the divorce, the husband disputed a business valuation and claimed loans as marital debt. The court found his loan documentation lacking credibility and upheld a valuation of $305,800.
